name: Sundrop Brands Ltd
title: Sundrop Brands Ltd - 500215 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated growth 11% with EBITDA margin ~7.2% ex one-offs, but no capacity or capex discussion; margin gains are cost-led, and management is reinvesting heavily in advertising and promising 100 bps plus 150-200 bps further expansion.

triggers.label: Margin expansion 150-225 bps p.a. for two years
triggers.quote: the range would be between 150 to 225-odd basis points

triggers.label: Q4 consolidated growth 11%
triggers.quote: we have delivered a revenue growth of 11% in the entire total business consolidated

triggers.label: Edible oil inflation passed to consumers
triggers.quote: we have passed out to the consumers very similarly either through price increases or grammage reductions

triggers.label: Italian value decline -4% in Q4
triggers.quote: Value terms, it is still a decline of 4%

triggers.label: Peanut butter losing share in MT and e-commerce
triggers.quote: we are losing share in modern trade and e -commerce

guidance.value: 150-225 bps p.a., ~200 bps midpoint; double-digit margin by FY29
guidance.quote: the range would be between 150 to 225-odd basis points
our growth on core categories will be about 12% to 13%

guidance.value: around 8% of top line over next 2 years
guidance.quote: potentially over the next 2 years, get to around 8% of top line as an organization

red_flags.label: Q4 ad spend reclassification flatters trend
red_flags.quote: there is a reclassification of visibility spend of close to INR6 crores in a single quarter

red_flags.label: Peanut butter losing share to low-priced entrants
red_flags.quote: the entry of low -priced competitive players in the commoditized section

evasions.quote: the growth are dominantly stand -alone growth of 2 businesses
